messages:
Leah CS: Heads up — Artemis Labs just triggered a large token spike during onboarding. Need a concise QBR-ready summary + mitigation plan. Anyone seen this pattern?
cost-bot: Alert: account=Artemis Labs usage increased 3.6x over 24h, projected 7-day burn +420% :warning:
Marco (CSM): Thats alarmingly high. Did they run a full reindex or some debug job?
Leah CS: They imported a customer dataset then kicked off large similarity scans + embeddings. Quick raw snapshot:```24h_total_tokens: 2,150,432
avg_per_call: 43,210
calls: 49
large_jobs: 3```
Priya Finance: If we don't intervene, their credits runway hits zero in ~9 days. Ill produce a 30-day forecast but we should assume mitigations first.
Samir Eng: Short-term mitigation we can flip now: route heavy embedding work to a cheaper embedding variant, enable batching and prefix caching. Proposed config:```route: embeddings -> model: tiny-embed-v2
batch_size: 64
cache_prefix: enabled
throttle: 60rps for similarity endpoints```
Marco (CSM): Ill own the customer comms. Plan: propose 7-day throttle + enablement workshop to optimize their queries. Need a plain-language note explaining the temporary model switch and expected cost impact.
Nora Product: For the QBR deck callout: root cause (bulk ingestion + synchronous similarity runs), immediate mitigations (throttle, model swap, batching), and long-term recommendations (precompute embeddings, scheduled reindexing, quota guardrails). Add estimated token savings for each mitigation.
Leah CS: Action list: 1) Marco -> message Artemis with proposed plan and ask for ack (ETA: 2pm PT) 2) Samir -> implement routing rule + rollback (ETA: EOD) 3) Priya -> update 30-day spend forecast and flag renewal risk (ETA: 4pm) 4) Nora -> slide for QBR with impact estimates and timeline.
Priya Finance: I'll also set temporary budget alerts (email + slack) at 60% and 90% of their commit so we have early warnings.
Samir Eng: Will roll a small canary for routing and paste canary logs here. Expect minimal latency diff.
Marco (CSM): Draft to Artemis: "We noticed elevated embedding runs post-import. To prevent credit depletion, we recommend a brief throttling window and temporary switch to a cost-optimized embedding model while we run a short enablement session to optimize usage." Can someone soften the tone / approve?
Leah CS: Approved. Offer a 30-45min enablement session this week to walk queries and batching.
cost-bot: Note: auto-logged incident #INC-2023159 for Artemis Labs, severity=medium, owner=Marco (CSM)
Marco (CSM): Sent the message; customer ACKd and agreed to throttle + session. They asked if we can temporarily expand credits if the mitigation doesn't hit quickly  I'll coordinate after Priya posts the forecast.
Priya Finance: Copy. Modeling a temporary cushion now, will drop numbers in the forecast doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/artemis/forecast (will paste summary here once done).
Leah CS: Good. Please keep this thread updated so I can capture exact numbers for the QBR.
Samir Eng: Canary live: perf looks good. Pasting quick canary log summary:```canary_ok: true
median_latency_change: +12ms
token_savings_est: ~58% on embedding ops
errors: 0/500 calls```
Leah CS: Perfect. We'll include the mitigation timeline and savings estimate on the QBR slide. Closing loop once Priya finalizes the forecast. Thanks all :thumbsup:
